# browser-control-layer

> Browser control skill pack for AI agents: route web jobs, batch steps, hand clicks to a fresh runner, and close and check what it opens.

Install: `npx browser-control-layer`. Preview: `npx browser-control-layer install --dry-run`.

## Docs

- [Skill](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/skills/browser-control-layer/SKILL.md): Read the invocation steps.
- [Method](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/docs/METHOD.md): Browser practices and rationale.
- [Results](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/docs/RESULTS.md): Package measurements and rerun commands.

## Reference

- [Commands](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/README.md): Command entry points and companion credits.
